about_the_game:
After disaster strikes a remote moon research base, your escape pod malfunctions and crash-lands on an Earth-like planet. Stranded with limited supplies, you must explore your surroundings, gather resources, and build shelter to survive.

Once your basic needs are met, your goal becomes clear: build a new ship and escape the planet. But you quickly discover you are not alone. Hostile creatures roam the surface, and you must fight to survive. Are they connected to the catastrophe that left you stranded?

Escaping the planet is only the beginning. Launch back into space and explore other planets and moons as you uncover what happened to the research base, why no one has come to rescue you, and how this mysterious threat has infected the solar system. Your journey back to civilization will not be easy and the entire galaxy may depend on you.


Survival Mode drops you into a procedurally generated Earth-like world with nothing but your escape pod and your instincts. 

Start by crafting basic tools to gather resources through foraging, hunting, and mining. Cook food to stay alive, build shelter to protect yourself from hostile creatures, and upgrade your equipment to survive increasingly dangerous threats. As you grow stronger, you’ll unlock farming, advanced crafting, and the ability to forge powerful gear and armor from rare ores hidden deep underground.

Explore diverse biomes filled with unique resources, creatures, and dangers. Delve into dungeons, battle hostile enemies, and take on powerful bosses guarding valuable technology and materials. Each victory unlocks the technology and materials you need to build your spaceship and return to space.

Eventually, survival turns into exploration on a cosmic scale. Build your own spaceship, take to the skies, and pilot your way to other moons and planets across the solar system. New worlds bring harsher conditions, tougher enemies, and more advanced resources, challenging you to adapt once again as the mystery of the system unfolds.

S

Creative Mode removes all limits and lets you focus purely on building, experimentation, and artistic expression. With no story, no survival pressure, and unlimited resources, the entire solar system becomes your canvas.

Build freely using a hexagon-based construction system that opens up new shapes and design possibilities not possible with traditional block grids. From intricate architecture to sweeping landscapes, Creative Mode encourages you to think beyond straight lines and flat worlds.

Carve, sculpt, and reshape entire planets into living dioramas. Hollow out worlds, create floating cities, or craft detailed scenes that wrap seamlessly around fully spherical planets. Whether you’re working on a small artistic vignette or transforming an entire planet, the scale is entirely up to you.

Designed to be relaxing and meditative, express yourself, and enjoy the simple joy of creation just for the sake of making something beautiful.

Every world in the solar system is fully procedural, generated using simulation-driven climate and terrain models to create believable, explorable planets.

Our biome placement is guided by climate systems such as temperature, elevation, rainfall, and latitude. This means deserts form where you expect them, forests grow in suitable climates, and icy regions gather near the poles. By following real-world environmental logic, exploration becomes more intuitive and rewarding. Players can predict where certain resources and biomes are likely to exist, making discovery feel natural instead of random.

But PlanetSmith isn’t limited to Earth-like worlds.

Beyond familiar environments lie strange and wonderful alien landscapes. You may discover methane ocean worlds, bizarre geological formations, and maze-like terrain that twists across entire planets. Each new moon or planet brings unexpected environments, resources, and challenges to uncover.

WHERE WE ARE HEADING

  • Embark on a journey of discovery after awakening in a mysterious new world teeming with opportunities, challenges and hidden dangers. Explore and gather essential resources to construct shelters to ensure survival and success.

  • Forge tools that enable you to dig deep into the earth, unearthing hidden treasures and uncovering ancient secrets. Gather precious materials and grow crafting prowess, which leads to the ability to fashion increasingly advanced gear that opens up new horizons of exploration.

  • Choose a destiny – tame the planet and its mysteries, or become the ultimate explorer by designing and building an interplanetary spaceship capable of taking you to the stars.

  • Dive into a tranquil realm of boundless creativity with Creative Mode. Step into a world where imagination sets the course – sculpt landscapes, erect monumental structures, craft intricate houses, or even breathe life into colossal characters; the possibilities are ready and waiting to be defined. Unleash artistic spirit, design awe-inspiring monuments, and then proudly showcase any creations, inviting others to marvel at these displays of ingenuity.

  • OS *: Windows 7

  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 660, 2 GB | AMD Radeon HD 7870, 2 GB

short_description: PlanetSmith is a sandbox survival RPG set across fully spherical, procedurally generated voxel worlds. Explore alien planets, build anything you can imagine, fight dangerous creatures, and seamlessly launch into space to continue your adventure across a living solar system.
supported_languages:
English*, Spanish - Spain*
*languages with full audio support
